sentences.en: For each real channel use, the receiver observes Y equals X plus Z.
sentences.zh: 每次实信道使用中，接收端观测Y=X+Z。

sentences.en: The noise Z is Gaussian with mean zero and variance N.
sentences.zh: 噪声Z服从均值零、方差N的高斯分布。

sentences.en: Assume N is strictly positive.
sentences.zh: 假设N严格为正。

sentences.en: Across uses, the noises are independent and identically distributed.
sentences.zh: 各次使用中的噪声独立同分布。

sentences.en: They are also independent of the message and transmitted codeword.
sentences.zh: 噪声还与消息及发送码字独立。

sentences.en: A block code assigns one real vector x of length n to each message m.
sentences.zh: 分组码为每个消息m分配一个长度为n的实向量x。

sentences.en: The transmitted vector is the codeword associated with the selected message.
sentences.zh: 发送向量就是所选消息对应的码字。

sentences.en: Constrain every codeword separately. With n equal to two and P equal to one, does a codeword with both coordinates equal to one point five qualify?
sentences.zh: 每个码字分别受约束。当n为二、P为一时，点(1.5,1.5)合格吗？

sentences.en: For every message m, its squared Euclidean norm is at most n times P.
sentences.zh: 对每个消息m，其欧几里得范数平方至多为nP。

sentences.en: Equivalently, the average squared coordinate of each codeword is at most P.
sentences.zh: 等价地，每个码字的坐标平方平均至多为P。

sentences.en: This is stronger than bounding power only after averaging over messages.
sentences.zh: 这比只对消息平均后限制功率更强。

sentences.en: The parameter P is nonnegative.
sentences.zh: 参数P非负。

sentences.en: When P is zero, every allowed codeword must be the zero vector.
sentences.zh: 当P为零时，每个允许码字都必须是零向量。

sentences.en: The output then contains only noise, so reliable positive-rate communication is impossible.
sentences.zh: 此时输出只有噪声，因此无法可靠传输正速率。

sentences.en: The signal-to-noise ratio is P divided by N.
sentences.zh: 信噪比是P除以N。

sentences.en: Both P and N are measured per real channel use.
sentences.zh: P与N都按每次实信道使用计量。

sentences.en: The capacity will therefore be measured in bits per real use.
sentences.zh: 因此容量单位是每次实信道使用的比特数。

sentences.en: Each use contributes one scalar coordinate to the block.
sentences.zh: 每次使用向分组贡献一个标量坐标。

sentences.en: The channel law is memoryless because each output uses its own independent noise.
sentences.zh: 由于每个输出使用各自独立的噪声，该信道是无记忆的。

sentences.en: The input coordinates need not be independent for the converse.
sentences.zh: 反向证明不要求输入坐标相互独立。

sentences.en: The code may coordinate all coordinates of a codeword.
sentences.zh: 编码器可以协调一个码字的所有坐标。

sentences.en: Only the total squared norm of each codeword is constrained.
sentences.zh: 约束的只是每个码字的总范数平方。

sentences.en: We first use this exact constraint to bound every reliable code.
sentences.zh: 我们先用这一精确约束界定所有可靠码。

sentences.en: Then random Gaussian codewords will approach the bound while respecting it.
sentences.zh: 随后将用高斯随机码字逼近该界并满足约束。

sentences.en: The random ensemble itself may contain codewords that exceed the limit.
sentences.zh: 随机码本整体中可能含有超出限制的码字。

sentences.en: The proof will remove those words before claiming a valid code.
sentences.zh: 证明会在宣称码本有效之前删去这些码字。

sentences.en: Keep this distinction between an ensemble and a selected codebook.
sentences.zh: 请区分随机码本集合与最终选定的码本。

sentences.en: No probability average can replace the requirement on every retained message.
sentences.zh: 对概率取平均不能替代对每个保留消息的要求。

sentences.en: The model is now fixed for the converse and achievability arguments.
sentences.zh: 现在模型已固定，可以进行反向证明与可达性证明。

sentences.en: We next derive the rate ceiling from Fano and Gaussian entropy.
sentences.zh: 接下来用Fano不等式和高斯熵推出速率上界。

sentences.en: Consider a code with M equiprobable messages and block length n.
sentences.zh: 考虑含M个等概率消息、块长为n的码。

sentences.en: Let the average decoding error probability be P sub e.
sentences.zh: 令平均译码错误概率为Pe。

sentences.en: Fano bounds the remaining message uncertainty by one plus P sub e times log base two of M.
sentences.zh: Fano不等式将剩余消息不确定性界为1加Pe log₂M。

sentences.en: The product of one minus P sub e and log base two of M, minus one, is at most the message-output mutual information.
sentences.zh: 因此(1−Pe)log₂M−1不超过消息与输出的互信息。

sentences.en: The encoded vector is a deterministic function of the message.
sentences.zh: 编码向量是消息的确定函数。

sentences.en: The message, codeword, and output form a Markov chain in that order.
sentences.zh: 消息、码字与输出依次构成马尔可夫链。

sentences.en: Data processing bounds message-output information by codeword-output information.
sentences.zh: 由数据处理不等式，消息与输出的互信息不超过码字与输出的互信息。

sentences.en: Independence of noise gives codeword-output information as h of Y block minus h of Z block.
sentences.zh: 噪声独立，因此码字与输出互信息为h(Y^n)−h(Z^n)。

sentences.en: The output block entropy is at most the sum of its coordinate entropies.
sentences.zh: 输出块熵至多为各坐标熵之和。

sentences.en: This is entropy subadditivity; the outputs need not be independent.
sentences.zh: 这是熵的次可加性；输出不必相互独立。

sentences.en: For each coordinate, Gaussian noise is independent of the input coordinate.
sentences.zh: 对每个坐标，高斯噪声与输入坐标独立。

sentences.en: Therefore its output variance equals input variance plus N.
sentences.zh: 因此输出方差等于输入方差加N。

sentences.en: Input variance is no greater than input second moment.
sentences.zh: 输入方差不超过输入二阶矩。

sentences.en: The maximum-entropy property bounds each output entropy by a Gaussian entropy.
sentences.zh: 最大熵性质用高斯熵界定每个输出熵。

sentences.en: Subtract the entropy of the independent Gaussian noise in every coordinate.
sentences.zh: 在每个坐标上减去独立高斯噪声的熵。

sentences.en: The result is at most one half log two of one plus input second moment over N.
sentences.zh: 结果至多为二分之一log₂(1加输入二阶矩除以N)。

sentences.en: Summing leaves one logarithm for each coordinate.
sentences.zh: 求和后每个坐标贡献一个对数项。

sentences.en: The codeword constraint bounds the sum of these second moments by n times P.
sentences.zh: 码字约束将这些二阶矩之和限制为nP。

sentences.en: Apply Jensen because log one plus power over N is concave.
sentences.zh: 由于log(1加功率除以N)是凹函数，应用Jensen不等式。

sentences.en: The average of the logarithms is at most the logarithm at average power.
sentences.zh: 对数的平均值至多为平均功率处的对数。

sentences.en: This gives mutual information at most n divided by two, times log base two of one plus P over N.
sentences.zh: 由此互信息至多为n/2 log₂(1+P/N)。

sentences.en: The factor one half comes from a real Gaussian degree of freedom.
sentences.zh: 因子二分之一来自一个实高斯自由度。

sentences.en: It is not a conversion from bits per use to bits per second.
sentences.zh: 它不是从每次使用比特数换算成每秒比特数。

sentences.en: Combine this bound with Fano and divide by n.
sentences.zh: 将此界与Fano不等式合并并除以n。

sentences.en: For a sequence of codes with P sub e tending to zero, the limiting rate cannot exceed this value.
sentences.zh: 若一列码的Pe趋于零，其极限速率不超过该值。

sentences.en: When P is zero, the expression is zero, matching the noise-only channel.
sentences.zh: 当P为零时，该表达式为零，与纯噪声信道相符。

sentences.en: For positive P and N, the ceiling is one half log two of one plus SNR.
sentences.zh: 当P与N为正时，上界为二分之一log₂(1+SNR)。

sentences.en: The proof used the power of every codeword, not merely ensemble-average power.
sentences.zh: 证明使用了每个码字的功率，而非仅用码本平均功率。

sentences.en: We next construct codes approaching any rate below the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 接下来构造逼近该上界以下任意速率的码。

sentences.en: The construction needs a fixed power margin before selecting a deterministic code.
sentences.zh: 该构造需要先留出固定功率裕量，再选出确定码。

sentences.en: That margin makes the later expurgation rigorous.
sentences.zh: 该裕量使后续删选步骤严格成立。

sentences.en: Assume P is positive and choose a fixed P prime strictly between zero and P.
sentences.zh: 假设P为正，选取固定的P′，使0<P′<P。

sentences.en: Generate each codeword with independent, zero-mean Gaussian coordinates of variance P prime.
sentences.zh: 为每个码字生成独立、零均值、方差P′的高斯坐标。

sentences.en: Choose a positive rate R below one half log two of one plus P prime over N.
sentences.zh: 选择正速率R，低于0.5log₂(1+P′/N)。

sentences.en: The information density between one true codeword and its output has that mean.
sentences.zh: 真实码字与其输出之间的信息密度均值就是该量。

sentences.en: The output is zero-mean Gaussian with variance P prime plus N.
sentences.zh: 输出为零均值、方差P′+N的高斯。

sentences.en: Subtracting the Gaussian noise entropy gives exactly that mutual information.
sentences.zh: 减去高斯噪声熵，恰好得到该互信息。

sentences.en: Use M equal to the integer floor of two raised to n times R messages.
sentences.zh: 取消息数M=⌊2^(nR)⌋。

sentences.en: Fix epsilon positive with three epsilon smaller than the gap I minus R.
sentences.zh: 选定ε>0，使3ε小于I−R。

sentences.en: Independent coordinates make the true pair satisfy typical density tests with probability approaching one.
sentences.zh: 独立坐标使真实码字对以趋近一的概率满足典型密度检验。

sentences.en: Use three negative-log-density tests for input, output, and their joint law.
sentences.zh: 分别对输入、输出及联合分布使用三项负对数密度检验。

sentences.en: Their empirical negative log densities approach the corresponding expectations by the law of large numbers.
sentences.zh: 由大数定律，其经验负对数密度趋于相应期望。

sentences.en: A wrong codeword is independent of the received output under the ensemble.
sentences.zh: 在随机码本集合下，错误码字与接收输出相互独立。

sentences.en: This independence is exact, not an approximation.
sentences.zh: 这种独立是精确的，而非近似。

sentences.en: On the joint typical set, the likelihood ratio is exponentially large.
sentences.zh: 在联合典型集上，似然比呈指数级增大。

sentences.en: Joint surprisal bounds make fXY at least two raised to negative n times (hXY plus epsilon).
sentences.zh: 联合自信息界使f_XY^n至少为2^(−n(h(X,Y)+ε))。

sentences.en: Input and output surprisal bounds make fX and fY at most two raised to negative n times (their entropies minus epsilon).
sentences.zh: 输入与输出自信息界使f_X^n、f_Y^n至多为各自2^(−n(h−ε))。

sentences.en: Their product divided by fXY is at most two raised to negative n times (I minus three epsilon).
sentences.zh: 二者乘积除以fXY至多为2^(−n(I−3ε))。

sentences.en: Integrate under the independent product law and replace its density by that ratio times fXY.
sentences.zh: 在独立乘积分布下积分，并将其密度改写为该比值乘fXY。

sentences.en: The joint probability of the typical set is at most one.
sentences.zh: 联合典型集的概率至多为一。

sentences.en: Therefore the independent wrong-pair probability is at most two raised to negative n times (I minus three epsilon).
sentences.zh: 因此独立错误码字对概率至多为2^(−n(I−3ε))。

sentences.en: A union bound over fewer than two raised to n times R competitors makes this vanish when R is below I.
sentences.zh: 当R<I时，对少于2^(nR)个竞争码字作并集界可使概率趋零。

sentences.en: Together with the true-pair atypical probability, ensemble-average error tends to zero.
sentences.zh: 结合真实码字对的非典型概率，码本集合平均错误趋于零。

sentences.en: Now check power separately for each generated codeword.
sentences.zh: 现在分别检查每个生成码字的功率。

sentences.en: Its coordinate squares are independent with mean P prime.
sentences.zh: 其坐标平方独立，均值为P′。

sentences.en: The law of large numbers makes the probability of average power above P tend to zero.
sentences.zh: 大数定律使平均功率超过P的概率趋于零。

sentences.en: The strict power margin matters. If P prime equals P, must the overpowered fraction still vanish?
sentences.zh: 严格功率裕量很关键。如果P′等于P，超功率比例还一定趋于零吗？

sentences.en: At variance exactly P, exceedance probability need not tend to zero.
sentences.zh: 方差恰为P时，超限概率未必趋于零。

sentences.en: The expected fraction of overpowered codewords therefore tends to zero.
sentences.zh: 因此，超功率码字比例的期望趋于零。

sentences.en: Let beta n denote that expected fraction and epsilon n the expected average decoding error.
sentences.zh: 令βₙ为该比例期望，εₙ为平均译码错误的期望。

sentences.en: Both quantities tend to zero.
sentences.zh: 这两个量都趋于零。

sentences.en: Select a deterministic codebook whose actual average error plus actual overpowered fraction is at most epsilon n plus beta n.
sentences.zh: 选定确定码本，使其实际平均错误加实际超功率比例不超过εₙ+βₙ。

sentences.en: In that codebook, discard every overpowered message.
sentences.zh: 在该码本中，删去所有超功率消息。

sentences.en: Define delta n as epsilon n plus beta n, which tends to zero.
sentences.zh: 定义δₙ=εₙ+βₙ，它趋于零。

sentences.en: If delta n is zero, all messages already have valid power and zero error.
sentences.zh: 若δₙ为零，则所有消息都满足功率且错误为零。

sentences.en: Otherwise also discard messages whose conditional error exceeds square root delta n.
sentences.zh: 否则，再删去条件错误超过√δₙ的消息。

sentences.en: Markov inequality bounds the latter fraction by square root of delta n.
sentences.zh: Markov不等式将后者比例界为√δₙ。

sentences.en: The total discarded fraction is at most delta n plus square root delta n.
sentences.zh: 总删去比例至多为δₙ+√δₙ。

sentences.en: Reassign deleted decoding outputs to retained messages, preserving every retained correct region.
sentences.zh: 将已删消息的译码输出重新分给保留消息，保留原有正确区域。

sentences.en: Every retained codeword satisfies the power constraint individually.
sentences.zh: 每个保留码字都逐个满足功率约束。

sentences.en: Every retained message has conditional error tending uniformly to zero.
sentences.zh: 每个保留消息的条件错误率都一致趋于零。

sentences.en: Retaining a fraction tending to one changes the rate by a quantity tending to zero.
sentences.zh: 保留趋于一的比例只使速率改变趋零量。

sentences.en: For each fixed P prime, rates below its Gaussian mutual information are achievable.
sentences.zh: 对每个固定P′，低于其高斯互信息的速率均可达。

sentences.en: Finally let P prime increase toward P.
sentences.zh: 最后令P′逐渐增至P。

sentences.en: Continuity gives every rate strictly below the claimed capacity.
sentences.zh: 由连续性可得容量以下的每个严格较低速率。

sentences.en: If P is zero, the trivial zero-rate code handles the boundary.
sentences.zh: 若P为零，平凡零速率码处理该边界。

sentences.en: This is an existence proof, not a claim that every random codebook is good.
sentences.zh: 这是存在性证明，不表示每个随机码本都好。

sentences.en: A high-dimensional picture can explain the capacity formula intuitively.
sentences.zh: 高维图像可以直观解释容量公式。

sentences.en: Every permitted input vector lies inside the ball with radius equal to the square root of n times P.
sentences.zh: 每个允许输入向量都位于半径√(nP)的球内。

sentences.en: This input ball expresses the codeword constraint.
sentences.zh: 这个输入球表达码字约束。

sentences.en: It is not the numerator of the decisive output-volume ratio.
sentences.zh: 它不是关键输出体积比的分子。

sentences.en: For a zero-mean Gaussian input with variance P, typical output norm is about the square root of n times the sum P plus N.
sentences.zh: 零均值、方差P的高斯输入下，典型输出范数约为√(n(P+N))。

sentences.en: Typical noise norm is about the square root of n times N.
sentences.zh: 典型噪声范数约为√(nN)。

sentences.en: Thus the receiver-side region has squared radius about n times the sum P plus N.
sentences.zh: 因此接收端区域的半径平方约为n(P+N)。

sentences.en: Noise neighborhoods have squared radius about n times N. Which outer region belongs in the volume ratio?
sentences.zh: 噪声邻域的半径平方约为nN。体积比中应该用哪个外部区域？

sentences.en: Compare these receiver-side volumes, not the input ball against the noise ball.
sentences.zh: 比较的是接收端体积，而非输入球与噪声球。

sentences.en: In n real dimensions, ball volume is proportional to radius raised to power n.
sentences.zh: 在n维实空间中，球体积正比于半径的n次方。

sentences.en: The ratio therefore contributes one half log two of P plus N over N.
sentences.zh: 该比值因此贡献二分之一log₂((P+N)/N)。

sentences.en: This simplifies to one half log two of one plus P over N.
sentences.zh: 这化简为二分之一log₂(1+P/N)。

sentences.en: The exponent one half comes from comparing squared radii.
sentences.zh: 指数中的二分之一来自比较半径平方。

sentences.en: A packing picture places distinguishable noise neighborhoods inside the output region.
sentences.zh: 打包图像将可区分的噪声邻域置于输出区域内。

sentences.en: The volume ratio suggests how many neighborhoods can fit exponentially.
sentences.zh: 体积比提示可指数级容纳多少个邻域。

sentences.en: Taking logarithms converts that count into bits per coordinate.
sentences.zh: 取对数便将该数量转换为每坐标比特数。

sentences.en: This is an analogy for the exponent, not a disjoint-sphere proof.
sentences.zh: 这是指数率的类比，并非互不相交球的证明。

sentences.en: Actual Gaussian codewords are not a perfect sphere packing.
sentences.zh: 实际高斯码字并非完美球堆积。

sentences.en: The earlier random-coding argument supplies the probability proof.
sentences.zh: 前面的随机编码论证才提供概率证明。

sentences.en: The converse also came from entropy rather than literal packing.
sentences.zh: 反向证明也来自熵界，而非字面球堆积。

sentences.en: The separate input ball remains useful as a visual power check.
sentences.zh: 单独的输入球仍可用于可视化功率检查。

sentences.en: Keep its radius label distinct from the output radius.
sentences.zh: 要将它的半径标签与输出半径区分开。

sentences.en: The noise radius represents uncertainty remaining after the signal arrives.
sentences.zh: 噪声半径表示信号到达后仍然存在的不确定性。

sentences.en: More signal power enlarges the output region relative to noise.
sentences.zh: 信号功率越大，输出区域相对噪声区域越大。

sentences.en: That enlarges the volume ratio and the logarithmic rate.
sentences.zh: 这会增大体积比和对数速率。

sentences.en: Increasing noise has the opposite effect.
sentences.zh: 增大噪声则产生相反效果。

sentences.en: The formula is exact even though this geometric story is approximate.
sentences.zh: 尽管几何解释近似，容量公式本身是精确的。

sentences.en: Typical regions concentrate probability rather than contain every possible vector.
sentences.zh: 典型区域集中大部分概率，而非包含所有可能向量。

sentences.en: Next restrict the input to two antipodal signal points.
sentences.zh: 接下来将输入限制为两个相反信号点。

sentences.en: That finite alphabet creates a different information curve.
sentences.zh: 这个有限字母表会产生不同的信息曲线。

sentences.en: BPSK restricts the input to two real values, plus square root P and minus square root P.
sentences.zh: BPSK将输入限制为两个实数值：正√P与负√P。

sentences.en: For this binary-input Gaussian channel, equiprobable symbols maximize mutual information.
sentences.zh: 对此二元输入高斯信道，等概率符号使互信息最大。

sentences.en: For a fixed channel, mutual information is concave in the input distribution.
sentences.zh: 固定信道时，互信息关于输入分布是凹函数。

sentences.en: Reflection swaps the two input symbols and preserves the channel law.
sentences.zh: 反射会交换两个输入符号，并保持信道规律不变。

sentences.en: Averaging an input law with its reflection gives equal probabilities without reducing information.
sentences.zh: 将输入分布与其反射取平均便得到等概率，且不会降低互信息。

sentences.en: Reflecting the output swaps the two conditional Gaussian density curves.
sentences.zh: 反射输出坐标会交换两个条件高斯密度曲线。

sentences.en: The binary input has one bit of entropy under this distribution.
sentences.zh: 该输入分布下二元输入熵为一比特。

sentences.en: The receiver observes the noisy real value R.
sentences.zh: 接收端观测含噪实数R。

sentences.en: A soft decision retains sign and magnitude. Do received values .25 and 2 imply the same confidence?
sentences.zh: 软判决保留符号与幅度。接收值0.25和2意味着相同置信度吗？

sentences.en: A hard decision keeps only whether R is positive or negative.
sentences.zh: 硬判决只保留R为正还是为负。

sentences.en: The sign operation is a deterministic function of the soft observation.
sentences.zh: 取符号是软观测的确定函数。

sentences.en: Data processing therefore gives hard-decision information no greater than soft information.
sentences.zh: 由数据处理不等式，硬判决信息不超过软信息。

sentences.en: Normalize the observation by square root N, giving unit noise variance and signal power gamma equal to P over N.
sentences.zh: 将观测除以√N，噪声方差归一为一，信号功率γ=P/N。

sentences.en: The natural log likelihood ratio for a received value r equals two square root P times r divided by N.
sentences.zh: 接收值r的自然对数似然比为2√P·r/N。

sentences.en: The posterior probability of the positive symbol is one divided by one plus the exponential of minus that ratio.
sentences.zh: 正符号的后验概率为1/[1+exp(−该对数似然比)]。

sentences.en: Conditional entropy averages the negative log posterior of the actual transmitted symbol.
sentences.zh: 条件熵对实际所发符号的负对数后验概率取平均。

sentences.en: Reflection symmetry makes that average identical for either transmitted sign.
sentences.zh: 反射对称性使两个发送符号对应的平均相同。

sentences.en: Given the positive symbol, substitute r equal square root P plus square root N times a standard normal variable.
sentences.zh: 给定正符号，代入r=√P+√N乘以标准正态变量。

sentences.en: The soft mutual information equals one minus an expected log expression.
sentences.zh: 软输出互信息等于一减去一个对数项的期望。

sentences.en: Draw a standard normal variable Z inside that expectation.
sentences.zh: 在该期望中取标准正态变量Z。

sentences.en: Then subtract the expectation of log two of one plus exp of negative two gamma minus two root gamma Z.
sentences.zh: 再减去log₂(1+exp(−2γ−2√γ Z))的期望。

sentences.en: This is a numerical integral over the standard normal density.
sentences.zh: 这是对标准正态密度的数值积分。

sentences.en: It is a computed formula value, not a measured experiment.
sentences.zh: 这是公式计算值，不是实验测量值。

sentences.en: For hard decisions, the error probability is Q of square root gamma.
sentences.zh: 硬判决的错误概率为Q(√γ)。

sentences.en: The resulting binary symmetric channel has information one minus binary entropy of that probability.
sentences.zh: 所得二元对称信道的互信息为一减该错误概率的二元熵。

sentences.en: At gamma one, soft information is about zero point four eight five nine four four bits per use.
sentences.zh: γ=1时，软信息约为每次使用0.485944比特。

sentences.en: The hard-decision value at that point is about zero point three six eight nine one seven bits per use.
sentences.zh: 同一点的硬判决信息约为每次使用0.368917比特。

sentences.en: At gamma ten, soft information is about zero point nine nine six seven five six bits per use.
sentences.zh: γ=10时，软信息约为每次使用0.996756比特。

sentences.en: Hard-decision information there is about zero point nine nine zero seven nine four bits per use.
sentences.zh: 此时硬判决信息约为每次使用0.990794比特。

sentences.en: Both values approach one bit at high signal-to-noise ratio.
sentences.zh: 信噪比很高时，两者都趋近一比特。

sentences.en: The soft value never exceeds the input entropy of one bit.
sentences.zh: 软信息不会超过一比特的输入熵。

sentences.en: The Gaussian-input formula has no such one-bit ceiling.
sentences.zh: 高斯输入公式没有这一比特上限。

sentences.en: Its input alphabet contains continuously many possible values.
sentences.zh: 它的输入字母表包含连续多个可能值。

sentences.en: The two capacities differ because the permitted input distributions differ.
sentences.zh: 两种容量不同，是因为允许的输入分布不同。

sentences.en: They use the same power and the same Gaussian noise variance.
sentences.zh: 它们使用相同功率与相同高斯噪声方差。

sentences.en: The formula does not imply BPSK achieves Gaussian-input capacity.
sentences.zh: 该公式不意味着BPSK达到高斯输入容量。

sentences.en: The next comparison uses identical power and noise for both input families at each SNR.
sentences.zh: 下一段在每个信噪比下，为两种输入族采用相同功率和噪声。

sentences.en: The numerical integration settings should accompany any plotted values.
sentences.zh: 绘制数值时应同时记录数值积分设置。

sentences.en: Compare both models at the same real-use power P and noise variance N.
sentences.zh: 在相同的每次实使用功率P与噪声方差N下比较两种模型。

sentences.en: The Gaussian-input capacity is one half log two of one plus P over N.
sentences.zh: 高斯输入容量为二分之一log₂(1+P/N)。

sentences.en: The BPSK information is the soft-output integral from the previous chapter.
sentences.zh: BPSK信息量是上一章的软输出积分。

sentences.en: Both quantities are measured in bits per real channel use.
sentences.zh: 两者单位都是每次实信道使用的比特数。

sentences.en: For normalized noise variance one, set P equal to the SNR value s.
sentences.zh: 噪声方差归一为一时，令P等于信噪比s。

sentences.en: At s equal one tenth, Gaussian capacity is about zero point zero six eight seven five two bits.
sentences.zh: s=0.1时，高斯容量约为0.068752比特。

sentences.en: BPSK soft information is about zero point zero six eight seven four three bits at the same point.
sentences.zh: 同一点的BPSK软信息约为0.068743比特。

sentences.en: At s equal one, the Gaussian value is one half bit.
sentences.zh: s=1时，高斯容量为二分之一比特。

sentences.en: BPSK gives about zero point four eight five nine four four bits at SNR one. Will it keep tracking the Gaussian curve at SNR ten?
sentences.zh: SNR为一时，BPSK约有0.485944比特。SNR升到十时，它还能继续紧随高斯曲线吗？

sentences.en: At s equal ten, Gaussian capacity is about one point seven two nine seven one six bits.
sentences.zh: s=10时，高斯容量约为1.729716比特。

sentences.en: BPSK soft information is about zero point nine nine six seven five six bits.
sentences.zh: BPSK软信息约为0.996756比特。

sentences.en: These values come from a finite-interval Gaussian quadrature calculation.
sentences.zh: 这些数值来自有限区间上的高斯求积计算。

sentences.en: The integration used standard normal values between negative twelve and twelve.
sentences.zh: 积分使用了负十二至十二之间的标准正态取值。

sentences.en: The reported quadrature errors were below four times ten to the negative nine.
sentences.zh: 报告的求积误差低于四乘十的负九次方。

sentences.en: The omitted normal tails have negligible probability at the displayed precision.
sentences.zh: 在所示精度下，被省略的正态尾部概率可忽略。

sentences.en: Those are numerical integration error estimates, not channel measurements.
sentences.zh: 这些是数值积分误差估计，不是信道测量。

sentences.en: At high SNR, BPSK approaches at most one bit per use.
sentences.zh: 高信噪比下，BPSK至多趋近每次使用一比特。

sentences.en: The Gaussian formula continues increasing without that finite-alphabet ceiling.
sentences.zh: 高斯公式则继续增长，不受有限字母表上限限制。

sentences.en: Hard decisions lie below soft decisions by data processing.
sentences.zh: 由数据处理不等式，硬判决低于软判决。

sentences.en: At SNR ten, the hard value is about zero point nine nine zero seven nine four bits.
sentences.zh: 信噪比为十时，硬判决值约为0.990794比特。

sentences.en: The soft value at the same SNR is about zero point nine nine six seven five six bits.
sentences.zh: 相同信噪比下，软判决值约为0.996756比特。

sentences.en: The difference comes from discarding the received magnitude.
sentences.zh: 差异来自丢弃接收幅值。

sentences.en: No additional noise was introduced by changing the decision rule.
sentences.zh: 改变判决规则并未引入额外噪声。

sentences.en: Rather, the hard output retains less information about the input.
sentences.zh: 相反，硬输出保留的输入信息更少。

sentences.en: At low SNR, the BPSK and Gaussian curves are close.
sentences.zh: 低信噪比时，BPSK与高斯曲线接近。

sentences.en: At high SNR, the alphabet restriction dominates the gap.
sentences.zh: 高信噪比时，字母表限制主导两者差距。

sentences.en: The comparison assumes equal average power and equal noise variance.
sentences.zh: 该比较假设平均功率与噪声方差相同。

sentences.en: The Gaussian capacity permits optimized continuous input distributions.
sentences.zh: 高斯容量允许优化连续输入分布。

sentences.en: BPSK permits only its two antipodal signal values.
sentences.zh: BPSK只允许两个相反的信号值。

sentences.en: This distinction separates modulation performance from the channel coding limit.
sentences.zh: 这一区别将调制性能与信道编码极限区分开。

sentences.en: The capacity formula remains the benchmark for all allowed codes.
sentences.zh: 容量公式仍是所有允许码的基准。

sentences.en: The next episode converts bits per use into bits per second using bandwidth.
sentences.zh: 下一集将利用带宽把每次使用比特数转换为每秒比特数。
